zh-Hans.subtitle: 训练、饮食与身体变化日记
zh-Hans.promotional_text: 在历史页集中查看今天、月历和分类统计。用肌群和器械筛选动作图片，快速进入训练；离线记录饮食，按需连接 Apple Health。无需注册账号。
zh-Hans.description:
每一组，每一餐，都有记录。

Leanora Fitness 是一本原生训练与饮食日记。安排训练、记录实际组数和每餐份量，再从日历中回看变化。无需注册，日常记录可以离线完成。

今日概览、月历与周回顾
从历史页顶部查看今天的训练、饮食与体重，再用月历按日查看训练、四餐和身体记录。切换训练、体重体脂、饮食及历史/统计，查看当月汇总；周回顾与完整统计仍可从菜单进入。分别了解训练天数与次数、完成组数、饮食记录覆盖。已知热量均值排除无已知值日期；有记录不等于全天完整，未知营养不会当作零。

动作历史与进步
从动作详情或训练指导进入逐次记录，查看同一动作、同种类型的已完成正式组。比较最近两次容量、实际负重、次数、时长或距离，并打开来源训练核对。负重、自重、辅助和计时分别统计，不估算 1RM，也不自动判断训练效果。

按自己的计划训练
建立训练模板，安排周计划与单次改期，设置目标组数、次数、负重和休息。也可直接开始自由训练，逐组记录、暂停后继续，查看上次表现或从历史再练一次。完成训练后可把正式组整理为模板草稿，检查后保存。

动作与原创记录内容
动作页以图片卡片浏览，按肌群侧栏和器械筛选，搜索名称或别名，收藏常练动作、查看最近使用。训练入口保留自由训练、模板与周计划。内置 882 个动作、1765 张离线指导图片，支持肌群、器械、难度和类型筛选，图片可全屏查看。另有 4 套原创范例计划、9 个可编辑模板和 12 篇训练记录指南。范例不预设个人负重，训练日由你安排。

把饮食记清楚
按早餐、午餐、晚餐和加餐记录。离线目录有 500 条来源食品、209 个独立中文名称，可按名称、别名、分类、收藏和最近使用查找。选择来源份量、快捷克数或上次克数，计算已知热量和宏量营养素。支持自定义食品与快速热量；未知营养明确标注。

复用常吃的一餐或一天
把食物存成可编辑组合餐，按半份、一份或多份预览后记录。也可复制历史餐次，或选择整日的部分餐次、先预览再确认。复制新增独立记录，保留份量、备注和营养快照；目标日已有内容保留。另有 6 套原创食物搭配、12 篇离线饮食记录指南。

记录身体变化
手动记录体重、体脂，查看 7 天或 30 天的训练、饮食与身体趋势。训练消耗不会自动重复加入饮食目标。

连接 Apple Health
由你选择系统访问权限和同步方向，管理训练、饮食、身体数据及可读活动摘要。可检查来源、同步状态和待处理记录，停止自动同步；导出历史记录需要单独确认。不授权健康访问，仍可手动记录。

数据保存在本机
支持 JSON 备份恢复、CSV 导出与预检导入，分别管理本机记录、外部健康缓存和本 App 写入的健康副本。请自行保存导出的备份。JSON 格式 2 需在 1.3 或更高兼容版本恢复，旧格式 1 仍支持导入。

界面及原创指南以中文提供，部分动作、食品名称和来源步骤保留英文。食品目录以基础食品为主。内容用于记录参考，不提供医疗诊断、治疗或个体营养处方。

支持：pengyuehui@gmail.com
隐私政策：https://leanora.ai/fitness/privacy/

en-US.subtitle: Workout & Nutrition Journal
en-US.promotional_text: Today and a monthly calendar in History, plus an exercise image gallery with muscle and equipment filters. Offline logging, optional Apple Health sync. Chinese UI.
en-US.description:
Every set. Every meal. A record that stays with you.

Leanora Fitness brings workouts, food portions and body measurements into a personal journal. No account is required, and everyday logging works offline. The interface and original guides are provided in Chinese; some exercise names, food names and source instructions remain in English.

TODAY, MONTHLY HISTORY AND WEEKLY RECAP
Open History for today's workout, nutrition and weight, followed by a monthly calendar. Switch between training, body and food records or view monthly statistics. Open a selected day's diary. Weekly recap and detailed trends remain in the menu. Track training days, workout counts, completed sets and food-record coverage. The known-energy average excludes dates without known energy. Having records does not mean a full day was logged. Unknown nutrients stay unknown.

EXERCISE HISTORY
View completed working sets for the same exercise and measurement type. Compare the latest two sessions and open each source workout. External load, bodyweight, assisted repetitions, time and distance use separate metrics. The app does not estimate 1RM or automatically judge training effectiveness.

TRAIN YOUR WAY
Build templates with target sets, repetitions, load and rest. Schedule a week or reschedule one occurrence. Start a free workout, add exercises, record each set, pause and continue. Review previous performance, reuse values for unfinished sets or repeat a completed workout. Turn working sets into an editable template draft before saving.

OFFLINE EXERCISE GALLERY
Browse image cards with muscle and equipment filters, name search, favorites and recent exercises. The training entry keeps free workouts, templates and schedules available. Explore 882 exercises and 1,765 bundled guidance images with full-screen viewing. Filter by muscle, equipment, difficulty or type. Favorite regular exercises and browse recently used ones. Four original example programs provide 9 editable templates, with 12 offline recording and review guides. Examples leave personal load and weekly scheduling to you. Images are static photos or illustrations.

KEEP A FOOD DIARY
Log breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks. Search 500 sourced foods with 209 independently prepared Chinese names. Combine name, alias, category, favorite and recent filters. Choose sourced portions, gram shortcuts or explicitly reuse a previous gram amount. Create custom foods or log quick calories. Missing macros are not inferred from calories.

REUSE MEALS OR A DAY
Save editable food combinations and preview fractional or multiple servings before recording. Copy a past meal or select meal categories from a day, preview and confirm independent entries. Portions, notes, nutrient snapshots and unknown values are preserved. Existing target-day records stay in place. Explore 6 original food-combination examples and 12 offline nutrition-recording guides in Chinese.

BODY TRENDS AND APPLE HEALTH
Log weight and body fat manually and review 7-day or 30-day trends. Exercise energy is not automatically added to food goals. Choose system Health access and sync directions for workouts, nutrition and body data. Review available activity summaries, sources, pending work and sync status, or stop automatic sync. Historical export requires separate confirmation. Manual logging works without Health access.

YOUR DATA ON YOUR DEVICE
Export JSON backups and CSV files, preview imports and restore backups. Manage local records, imported Health caches and Health copies written by this app separately. Keep your exported backups. JSON format 2 requires version 1.3 or a later compatible version to restore; format 1 remains readable.

The food catalog focuses on basic foods. Content supports personal recording and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment or individualized nutrition prescriptions.

Support: pengyuehui@gmail.com
Privacy: https://leanora.ai/fitness/privacy/
en-US.whats_new:
Today and Trends are now combined in History, with today's overview above a monthly calendar and training, body and food statistics.
The Training tab is now an exercise gallery with muscle categories, equipment filters, search, favorites and offline guidance images. Workouts, templates and schedules remain available from its training entry.
Fixed the first automatic Health sync path skipping the system access request and paused access selections not being restored. Failed requests now show diagnostic error information. Previously handled permissions can be adjusted in Apple Health.
Simplified main-page text and improved dark mode and large-text layouts. Existing records, backups and explicit historical export confirmation are preserved. The interface is provided in Chinese.
